name: Lola McKeldin
notable_stories: Called Barbara’s father Buckey, which Barbara’s mother hated.
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Barbara identifies Lola as one of her father’s sisters.
Recorded under her birth surname McKeldin (daughter of Charles E. McKeldin I and Emma Bell McKeldin). She likely took a husband's surname, which is not recorded.
Lola died of cancer after radiation and chemotherapy. [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 4155]
Lola E., aged 11, in the 1920 census at 1143 Carroll Street; not in the household in 1930.
